questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Rhinos?
Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2013 season?
How many runs separate the all-time #1 (Alison Hodgkinson) and #2 (Mignon du Preez) run-scorers (List A) in the 11/12 season?
questions.explanation: Alison Hodgkinson: 585 — Mignon du Preez: 558 — a gap of 27.

questions.question: At which ground did Gugu Ngcobo record their career-best innings (33*, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval, against Heat on 2022/02/06.

questions.question: At Newlands Stadium, who holds the record for 'Most Wickets' (T20)?
Who holds the record for 'Most 100+ Scores' in the 22/23 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Suné Luus holds it, with a total of 2, a joint record shared with Tazmin Brits and Izel Cilliers.
